description.message: Lets your Pulse learn from what you like and save on other sites, read here in your own browser.

addressHint.message: Where you open Pulse, such as http://192.168.1.20:3031

keyHint.message: From Settings in Pulse, under Connected accounts

sitesHint.message: A site you are signed in to in this browser is read every few days. Only titles and authors are sent to your Pulse.

problem_signed_out.message: Not signed in to this site in this browser.

problem_unreadable.message: The site's pages did not show your lists.

problem_unpaired.message: Your Pulse turned the key down. Pair again.

problem_failed.message: That did not work. Try again later.

permissionNeeded.message: The extension needs permission to reach that address.
